name: Druid's Deliverance
oracle_text: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you this turn. Populate. (Create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control.)
blocked_sentences: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to you this turn.

needs.what: a combat_only flag on the prevent_damage op (the player DamageShield), so a resolving instant installs a this_turn shield over its controller (player: you) that prevents only combat damage and lets noncombat damage to that player through
needs.why_existing_wont_do: prevent_damage the op takes only player and duration and its DamageShield prevents ALL damage to the player, so burn and drain would also be stopped -- a strictly better card; the prevent_damage static has combat_only but lives on a printed permanent, matches only permanents via affects (no way to name a seat), and has no 'this turn' duration, so a spell cannot install it. Populate itself is expressible (choose_permanents over creature tokens you control, then copy_permanent of the binding), so only the first sentence is blocked
